description: Creates a NEW TabTree kanban board in one call — columns and cards, each card with what TabTree shows on it: owner, start/due days, priority, colour labels, time estimate, Ai4X lever, note (links in it become clickable — a Google Meet link, a doc), a link, and sub-tasks. It opens directly as a kanban in TabTree, on every device signed in to the account, and in a TEAM space every member sees it. To add or move cards on an EXISTING kanban, use propose_changes instead.

cards.description: The cards, in order within each column. 300 max.

column.description: Column NAME (or id). Default: the first column

labels.description: Colour labels from: green, yellow, orange, red, purple, blue, sky, lime, pink, gray (name them with `labels` at the board level)

lever.description: Ai4X lever: human (stays human), think (think with Claude), accelerate (Claude Code or a connector), automate (a skill or a scheduled task)

link.description: An https:// or mailto: link on the card, or map:<file> to open another map from list_maps

note.description: The back of the card — plain text; http(s) and mailto links become clickable

subtasks.description: Sub-tasks, ticked on the back of the card (the card shows n/m)

columns.description: The columns, left to right. Omit for To do / Doing / Done. Mark ONE column done:true: a card put there is ticked, and unticking it sends it back. 12 max.

wip.description: Optional work-in-progress limit 1–99 (the column turns red above it — nothing is blocked)

folder.description: Optional folder, by NAME or full PATH.

labels.description: Optional names for the colour labels, e.g. { "red": "Bug", "green": "Quick win" }

space.description: Optional TabTree SPACE to put it in, by name — one of the user's spaces, or a TEAM space they are an editor of (every member then sees it). list_maps shows the spaces. Omit for the user's own library.

style.description: Optional look (same keys as create_mindmap: font, background, skin…).

name: create_kanban
